statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was performed.
The service supports the diagnoses of I49.5 and I48.0.
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197.
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
